title: Measure and Decompose the Whole Picture of Unequal Representation
text: decompose_unequal_representation() can used either candidate-level results data already aggregated party--district totals. candidate-level results supplied, function internally sums votes seats party within district. Candidate-level results can supplied one row per candidate. election can also supplied aggregating votes seats one row per party within district. data contain multiple elections, multiple years, nest data election apply decompose_unequal_representation() nested data frame.
code: library(wpur) candidate_results <- tibble::tribble(   ~district, ~party, ~candidate, ~votes, ~elected,   "D1", "Party A", "candidate a", 60, 1,   "D1", "Party A", "candidate b", 60, 1,   "D1", "Party B", "candidate c", 40, 0,   "D2", "Party A", "candidate d", 40, 0,   "D2", "Party B", "candidate e", 60, 1 )  decompose_unequal_representation(   data = candidate_results,   party_var = party,   district_var = district,   votes_var = votes,   elected_var = elected,   alpha = 2,   group_decomposition = "none",   election_info = FALSE ) #> # A tibble: 1 × 6 #>   group_decomposition whole_picture_of_unequal_representation disproportionality #>   <chr>                                                 <dbl>              <dbl> #> 1 none                                                  0.222            0.00556 #> # ℹ 3 more variables: intra_party_unequal_representation <dbl>, #> #   malapportionment <dbl>, wasted_votes <dbl> party_results <- tibble::tribble(   ~district, ~party, ~votes, ~elected,   "D1", "Party A", 120, 2,   "D1", "Party B", 40, 0,   "D2", "Party A", 40, 0,   "D2", "Party B", 60, 1 )  decompose_unequal_representation(   data = party_results,   party_var = party,   district_var = district,   votes_var = votes,   elected_var = elected,   alpha = 2,   group_decomposition = "none",   election_info = FALSE ) #> # A tibble: 1 × 6 #>   group_decomposition whole_picture_of_unequal_representation disproportionality #>   <chr>                                                 <dbl>              <dbl> #> 1 none                                                  0.222            0.00556 #> # ℹ 3 more variables: intra_party_unequal_representation <dbl>, #> #   malapportionment <dbl>, wasted_votes <dbl> multi_year_results <- tibble::tribble(   ~year, ~district, ~party, ~votes, ~elected,   2020, "D1", "Party A", 120, 2,   2020, "D1", "Party B", 40, 0,   2020, "D2", "Party A", 40, 0,   2020, "D2", "Party B", 60, 1,   2024, "D1", "Party A", 80, 1,   2024, "D1", "Party B", 80, 1,   2024, "D2", "Party A", 30, 0,   2024, "D2", "Party B", 70, 1 )  multi_year_results |>   tidyr::nest(data = !year) |>   dplyr::mutate(     result = purrr::map(       data,       \(data_by_year) {         decompose_unequal_representation(           data = data_by_year,           party_var = party,           district_var = district,           votes_var = votes,           elected_var = elected,           alpha = 2,           group_decomposition = "none",           election_info = FALSE         )       }     )   ) |>   dplyr::select(!data) |>   tidyr::unnest(result) #> # title: Decompose unequal representation — decompose_unequal_representation
text: decompose_unequal_representation() aggregates candidate-level election results party--district totals decomposes alpha-divergence seat shares vote shares disproportionality, malapportionment, wasted votes, intra-party unequal representation.

title: Decompose unequal representation — decompose_unequal_representation
code: decompose_unequal_representation(   data,   party_var,   district_var,   votes_var,   elected_var,   alpha = 2,   group_decomposition = "none",   independent_label = "Independent",   election_info = FALSE )

title: Decompose unequal representation — decompose_unequal_representation
text: data data frame one row per candidate. party_var, district_var, votes_var, elected_var Unquoted column names identifying party, district, votes, election outcome variables. alpha Numeric scalar controlling alpha-divergence. alpha = 0 alpha = 1 use limiting forms. group_decomposition Character string selecting optional decomposition party-level disproportionality. One "none", "party_vs_independent", "multicandidate_vs_others". independent_label Character scalar used identify independents party_var. group_decomposition = "party_vs_independent", matching candidates renumbered internally independent treated separate party. election_info Logical scalar indicating whether election-level metadata added returned tibble.

title: Decompose unequal representation — decompose_unequal_representation
text: one-row tibble. always includes group_decomposition, whole_picture_of_unequal_representation, disproportionality, intra_party_unequal_representation, malapportionment, wasted_votes. Additional columns added grouped decomposition /election_info = TRUE requested.

title: Decompose unequal representation — decompose_unequal_representation
text: Districts votes_var entirely missing treated -contest districts excluded decomposition. Within district, votes_var must either fully observed fully missing.
